name: Yamaguchi Hijiri
source:
A high school girl who is dating Yusuke Maezono. She has a quiet personality and doesn’t talk much.
She has a somewhat stern appearance that makes her seem unapproachable, but she has a kind heart.
Yusuke and Hijiri were drawn to each other’s kindness and started dating.
They have no experience with kissing or sex; their relationship is platonic.
She is somewhat of a neat freak.
Although it’s not extreme, she also has a fear of men and is uncomfortable around men other than Yusuke.
She is a virgin.
